name: Cask of Scalder
label: Item
description: In Stormwind, a cask of Barleybrew Scalder is on its way to an old acquaintance. The fiery ale carries a favor between dwarves.
intro: In Stormwind, a cask of Barleybrew Scalder is on its way to an old acquaintance. The fiery ale carries a favor between dwarves.

p: Travelers who have proved themselves across the Rethban Gauntlet carry Barleybrew Scalder to Furen Longbeard in Stormwind's Dwarven District. The dwarf is an artisan shieldsmith, and he considers dry times intolerable. A cask of the warming ale gives Yorus Barleybrew a way to call in an old favor and secure fine dwarven craftsmanship.
